description: commute-reliability rules 3, 5 and 6, shared by web, Android and iOS. Inputs are built by tools/export-android-conformance.mjs; every expected value is declared by hand from the design and only checked against the web implementation. Never regenerate an expectation from the code under test.
encoding: Top-level times (nowMs, sightingAt, writes[].nowMs, fix.at, previousFix.at) are integer epoch milliseconds. Inside doc, records and journeys, times are ISO 8601 strings exactly as the web document and the departures API carry them. doc is the web personal document (client-storage.md); lastOpen.at is the record write time. A fix omits speed, heading or accuracy when unknown; an omitted value is never zero. journeyKey is the ordered list of [line name, scheduled departure] for every service leg.

holdCases.run: With doc.lastOpen as the stored record, ask whether incoming (a record written at nowMs, sighted by a fix taken at sightingAt, or unsighted when station is null) replaces it. expectedKept is stored or incoming.

cases.name: an unsighted write cannot replace a held record after departure
an unsighted write cannot replace a held record before departure
a write sighted at an intermediate station cannot replace it
a same-origin sighting before departure replaces it
a same-origin sighting for another trip before departure replaces it
a same-origin sighting 59.999 s after departure cannot replace it
a same-origin sighting 60 s after departure replaces it
a sighting fix taken before departure cannot replace it after departure
an unsighted stored record is not held
a record seen 15 min 1 s before departure is not held
a record seen after its own departure is not held
a record past arrival plus 30 min is not held
a record whose trip was deleted is not held
a record seen exactly 15 min before departure is held
a record at arrival plus 30 min exactly is held

entryCases.run: Apply each write in order through the hold rule (a write that replaces sets lastOpen = {at: its nowMs as ISO, ...record}). Then evaluate a Home fix at nowMs: platform-sighted inference from snapshot, then from the stored doc.lastOpen. expected is null or the entered focus: via, tripId, direction and journeyKey.

cases.name: regression: the open snapshot alone enters
regression: the stored record alone enters
regression: the open refresh writes an unsighted record before the fix
regression: the open refresh writes first and no snapshot exists (the native race)
Home stayed open through boarding: the held record enters on a moving tick fix
without movement toward the destination there is no entry
a recorded ride for the record journey blocks entry
an unexpired focus blocks entry
a journey whose mode is turned off cannot be entered
